description: This file defines an interface (IController) for controlling plugin host operations within the WPEFramework. It declares several pure virtual methods for persistence, deletion, reboot, environment retrieval, configuration management, and cloning of plugin instances.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: An interface for controlling plugin host operations, including persistence, deletion, reboot, environment, configuration, and cloning functionalities.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Persists the current state or configuration.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a resource specified by the given path.

methods.name: Reboot
methods.description: Reboots the plugin host or system.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieves the environment variables or settings associated with a given index.

methods.name: Configuration (getter)
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for a given callsign.

methods.name: Configuration (setter)
methods.description: Sets the configuration for a given callsign.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a plugin or resource based on the base callsign with a new callsign.
